title: How to Activate Sales Representative Tracking | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Activate Sales Representative Tracking Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000058393 Within the BD platform, it is possible to activate Sales Representative Tracking for members. To activate this feature, navigate to Settings >> Advanced Settings and search for: Enable Sales Rep Field In Edit Members Form System Variable: enable_sales_rep_field When activated, a new search field called Choose Sales Rep Name will be available under My Members > > Search Members: Also, a new filter will be added in the Finance >> Transaction History section: Assign a Sales Rep for each member by clicking on the Quick Edit option: And assign a Sales Rep directly under the Sales Representative field: This system name for the sales rep value is ref_code Now this information added will display as a dropdown option: Important Note: This field will be available as a column when Exporting Member Results as well. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
